items.title: Philippines calls for stronger UN cooperation on migration
items.description: The Philippines has called for stronger cooperation on safe, orderly and stronger migration among member-countries of the United Nations.

items.title: DICT probing data breach of 48 firms
items.description: The Department of Information and Communications Technology is investigating a potential data breach involving 48 companies participating in its trust assessment provider accredited program.

items.title: Ombudsman urges NBI: Pursue Davao flood control probe
items.description: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla has called on the National Bureau of Investigation to pursue its investigation on alleged irregularities in government-funded infrastructure projects in Davao City.

items.title: Lacson calls for ‘fair’ verdict in Duterte trial
items.description: Sen. Panfilo Lacson has called for a “fair” and “evidence-based” verdict in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte.

items.title: Queenie to exit PAR today
items.description: Severe tropical storm Queenie will exit the Philippine area of responsibility tonigth, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration said.

items.title: Duterte camp seeks cap on evidence
items.description: The defense team of former president Rodrigo Duterte has asked trial judges of the International Criminal Court to limit to 10,000 items the evidence that prosecutors can use in his upcoming trial for crimes against humanity.

items.title: Opposition lawmakers buck BSKE postponement
items.description: Progressive and opposition lawmakers in the House of Representatives have expressed their vehement objection to President Marcos’ signing of a new law, postponing anew the scheduled Nov. 2 barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan elections this year.

items.title: Marcos vows more assistance to MSMEs
items.description: President Marcos has vowed to assist micro, small and medium enterprises, the sector that contributes the most to the country’s employment, as he inspected yesterday a manufacturer of automobile parts, accessories, aluminum devices and metal components in Laguna.

items.title: Mary Jane reunited with family as free woman
items.description: Mary Jane Veloso was writing a poem in Filipino for a performance next Tuesday when cheers erupted inside the Correctional Institution for Women, as her fellow inmates celebrated the news that she had been granted an absolute pardon by President Marcos.

items.title: House ends plenary debates on 2027 budget
items.description: The House of Representatives has concluded its debates on the proposed P7.2 trillion national budget for2027, likely clearing the way for its passage on second reading early next month.

items.title: At long last, Mary Jane Veloso back home in Nueva Ecija
items.description: The moment that Mary Jane Veloso says she has fervently prayed for finally comes, following 16 long years of imprisonment

items.title: At Eurovision Asia, Carmelle steps onto her biggest stage yet
items.description: 'Gusto ko na makilala ako as someone na galing ng Pilipinas na magaling. Kahit papano, siguro mag-open din ‘yun ng door na mas makilala ‘yung ibang artist din na magagaling dito sa Pilipinas,' says Carmelle, the country's representative to Eurovision Asia

items.title: Record-breaking Albert Ian delos Santos earns Asian Games bronze
items.description: Filipino weightlifter Albert Ian delos Santos shatters his junior world and junior continental records on the way to an Asian Games bronze medal

items.title: TikTok reaches first state settlement in US over teen safety claims, agrees to user limits
items.description: Alabama secures $100 million settlement with TikTok, mandating new usage limits and age-verification measures to protect teens, as the state claims the platform endangers youth and misleads consumers about safety

items.title: Chris Gavina leaves UE, Paolo Hubalde takes over head coaching post
items.description: The coaching change comes as the UE Red Warriors battle through a 22-game losing streak dating back to October 2024

items.title: From Baguio to Sepang, Iñigo Anton gears up for biggest race of his career in F1 weekend
items.description: With a rookie title under his belt, Baguio’s Formula 4 driver Iñigo Anton heads to Sepang as the only Filipino on the grid, taking on the Malaysian circuit with an F1 crowd watching

items.title: The week in photos: September 19-25, 2026
items.description: A recap of news, sports, lifestyle, entertainment, and human interest images from the Philippines and around the globe

items.title: Ilokano filmmaker spotlights real-life queer choir stories
items.description: A former choir member himself, Ilokano filmmaker Ryand Angelo Ugalde shares the dilemma of a trans man singer: should he continue hormone replacement therapy or preserve the voice that helps fund his studies?

items.title: OpenAI works to understand full scope of agent activity as user data leak emerges
items.description: OpenAI grapples with rogue agent incidents as privacy risks mount, revealing challenges in controlling AI behavior and prompting calls for industry caution.

items.title: It’s an ADMM-Plus joint sail, but where were the Southeast Asians?
items.description: In an Philippine and Japan-hosted and ASEAN-led joint sail, most Southeast Asian navies were absent. So was China.
